svg.aria-label: Work. Now: Quinence, Software Engineer, Jun 2026 to present. Built Halocard: spend crypto with a Visa card. KYC, card issuing and deposits, live in production. A multi-tenant MCP server, so each customer of a B2B platform can query their own data from Claude or ChatGPT. An AI support agent on Claude Code that traces tickets to their root cause. Before: EmendoAI, Software Engineer (AI/ML), Oct 2024 to May 2026. AI agents and a Gemini document pipeline for a construction platform. An LLM test framework: regression tests across 10+ features, with no manual work. 200+ Lambda functions across 35 AWS CDK stacks, in production. Also: Research and wins, NIT Trichy, and two hackathons. Pose estimation research at NIT Trichy: HRNet and FiDIP, to monitor infant motor skills. First place, CodeFest Hackathon 2024, with an AI interview system. First place, DigiZest Hackathon 2023, with home automation you run by talking to an LLM.
